description: This file implements loop detection logic for agent tool calls, including functions for hashing calls, detecting loops such as repeated calls, polling, ping-pong patterns, and managing call history for session-based analysis.

methods.name: hashToolCall
methods.description: Creates a hash string for a tool call based on tool name and parameters for pattern matching.

methods.name: detectToolCallLoop
methods.description: Detects if an agent is stuck in a loop of tool calls, such as repeated calls with no progress or ping-pong patterns.

methods.name: recordToolCall
methods.description: Records a tool call in session history for loop detection.

methods.name: recordToolCallOutcome
methods.description: Records the outcome of a tool call, including result or error, to help detect no-progress repeats.

methods.name: getToolCallStats
methods.description: Provides statistics on tool call patterns within a session for debugging or monitoring.
